PRESIDENT
🦁
Ln. Neelima Bushpala
PRESIDENT · LIONS CLUB OF HYDERABAD WINGS · 2025–2026
Service is not what we do — it is who we are. This year, Lions Club of Hyderabad Wings has proven that when we stand together, no challenge is too great and no community too distant.

From Hunger Relief drives to Eye Vision Camps, from honouring our community's doctors to sponsoring a child's education — we have truly lived the Lions motto.

This digital scrapbook is a tribute to every Lion, every volunteer, and every partner who made our year of service possible. I am honoured to lead this magnificent pride.

Lead With Passion 2.0 · We Serve 🦁
